title: Animal Control Workers
description: Handle animals for the purpose of investigations of mistreatment, or control of abandoned, dangerous, or unattended animals.

tasks.text: Write reports of activities, and maintain files of impoundments and dispositions of animals.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Investigate reports of animal attacks or animal cruelty, interviewing witnesses, collecting evidence, and writing reports.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Investigation is human fieldwork with judgment

dwas.name: Examine crime scenes to obtain evidence.
Interview people to gather information about criminal activities.

tasks.text: Examine animals for injuries or malnutrition, and arrange for any necessary medical treatment.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical exam of bodies requires hands-on presence

dwas.name: Check physical condition of people or animals.

tasks.text: Contact animal owners to inform them that their pets are at animal holding facilities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Citations require on-scene judgment and legal authority

tasks.text: Educate the public about animal welfare, and animal control laws and regulations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public communication needs accountability and audience trust

dwas.name: Inform the public about policies, services or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Remove captured animals from animal-control service vehicles and place animals in shelter cages or other enclosures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Providing animal care is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Answer inquiries from the public concerning animal control operations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Public communication needs accountability and audience trust

dwas.name: Inform the public about policies, services or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Capture and remove stray, uncontrolled, or abused animals from undesirable conditions, using nets, nooses, or tranquilizer darts as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Providing animal care is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Use weapons or physical force to maintain security.

tasks.text: Prepare for prosecutions related to animal treatment, and give evidence in court.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Testimony carries legal accountability and live presence

dwas.name: Testify at legal or legislative proceedings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Supply animals with food, water, and personal care.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Providing animal care is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Issue warnings or citations in connection with animal-related offenses, or contact police to report violations and request arrests.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live incident response with agencies is human-led

dwas.name: Collaborate with law enforcement or security agencies to respond to incidents.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Euthanize rabid, unclaimed, or severely injured animals.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Providing animal care is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Clean facilities and equipment such as dog pens and animal control trucks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and equipment

tasks.text: Organize the adoption of unclaimed animals.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Providing animal care is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Examine animal licenses, and inspect establishments housing animals for compliance with laws.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Document validity check aided, human verifies authenticity

dwas.name: Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with security or safety regulations.
Examine personal documentation to ensure that it is valid.

tasks.text: Train police officers in dog handling and training techniques for tracking, crowd control, and narcotics and bomb detection.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Job-skill training content AI-assisted; coaching human

dwas.name: Train personnel to enhance job skills.

emerging_tasks.task: Deliver educational presentations on wildlife topics, such as animal safety, at schools and community events.
Pick up deceased animals from roadways and dispose of the animal carcasses.
Testify at court hearings when citations are contested.
Transport injured or ill wildlife to rescues.
